name: What are the best tile types for a shower?

mainEntity.name: What are the best tile types for a shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: For shower installations, durable and water-resistant tile types are essential. Popular choices include porcelain, ceramic, natural stone (such as granite, marble, or travertine), and glass tiles. Porcelain and ceramic are highly favored for their low porosity, durability, and wide range of styles. Natural stone offers a luxurious look but requires sealing and more maintenance. Glass tiles can add a unique aesthetic, often used as accents. The 'best' type depends on your budget, aesthetic preferences, and maintenance commitment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Best shower tile types include porcelain, ceramic, natural stone, and glass. Porcelain and ceramic are durable and water-resistant. Natural stone is luxurious but needs more maintenance.
